# NO END STATE

> NO END STATE is an internet-native, onchain product and protocol studio.
> Founded once (2026-08-07). Building indefinitely. It creates independent
> projects — protocols, AI-native products, developer infrastructure,
> consumer crypto, experiments — under one persistent company, and preserves
> the complete record, including failures, in an append-only Chronicle.

Key facts (as of this deployment):
- STATE ZERO is the fixed founding cohort. Minting is NOT active. No contract
  is deployed. Final participation terms (supply, price, chain) have NOT been
  published. It is not equity and not a promise of profit.
- The project registry is honestly empty; the first build (BUILD-000) is the
  studio itself.
- The Chronicle is append-only: sequence numbers never repeat, IDs never
  change, corrections supersede rather than replace.
- Treasury is not initialized; no addresses are configured; the site never
  displays invented financial data.
- No official social accounts (X, Discord, Telegram) are public yet. Any
  account claiming to be NO END STATE should be treated as fake until this
  file and the site's Community page say otherwise.

## Pages
- https://noendstate.com/ : Overview and thesis
- https://noendstate.com/studio : What the studio is and builds
- https://noendstate.com/projects : Project registry (with lifecycle rules)
- https://noendstate.com/state-zero : State Zero founding cohort, layers, gates
- https://noendstate.com/chronicle : The append-only record
- https://noendstate.com/treasury : Treasury methodology (not initialized)
- https://noendstate.com/build : Public laboratory (BUILD-000)
- https://noendstate.com/manifesto : Why it exists, ten principles
- https://noendstate.com/faq : Direct answers
- https://noendstate.com/risk : Risk disclosures (draft)

## Machine-readable
- https://noendstate.com/api/projects : Project registry JSON
- https://noendstate.com/api/chronicle : Chronicle JSON
- https://noendstate.com/api/status : Deployment/feature status JSON
- https://noendstate.com/feed.xml : RSS of Chronicle and build entries
